2026-11-10-SANM.thesis: Sanmina's fiscal Q4, reported Nov 9 after the close, beat widely (non-GAAP EPS $4.43 vs about $3.27 expected, revenue $3.86B vs $3.48B) and its first fiscal 2027 outlook (non-GAAP EPS $15.50-17.50, revenue $17.5-19.5B) sits about 17% above the $14.07 EPS consensus, with Q1 EPS guided to $3.50-3.85 vs $2.95 expected. A gap of about 20% on a guidance reset this large is the rulebook's best bucket (12%+ on a concrete estimate change), held about 20 trading days.
2026-11-10-SANM.wrong_if: closes below $150 (the whole gap given back), or Sanmina cuts or withdraws its fiscal 2027 outlook
